title: Lynkk for Consultants: Client Meetings and Workshops, Captured and Sent to Jira

lines: Five clients. A dozen workshops a week. One memory trying to keep up.
Two weeks later, the client asks who agreed to what.
Decisions get lost, write-ups take your evenings, and tasks never reach the delivery team.
Lynkk records client calls on the Mac or with the meeting bot, and workshops in the room through your browser.
In 17 languages, four of them in beta.
The Meeting Brief keeps decisions with their context, and action items with owners.
Send them to Jira from the note, one issue each.
Ask Lynkk what a client agreed, and play the moment it was said.
It finds notes by person, company or project.
Draft the report by talking. Hold a key on the Mac, and the words land where your cursor is.
Spend the time on the client. Lynkk keeps the notes.
